$comment: Canonical cross-repo analytics contract for earthity. Single source of truth consumed by earthity-website (static www marketing site) and earthity-dev (Outpost Next.js app). Both repos pull this via the earthity-design-system submodule. Human-readable companions in this folder: architecture.md, routes.md, analytics-events.md. Change events/cta/regions HERE, then update both consumers in lockstep.

properties.cta: which primary CTA role was clicked (one of the `cta` enum)
properties.page: normalized location.pathname the event fired on
properties.section: data-cta-section value identifying placement within a page
properties.label: trimmed visible text of the clicked element
properties.destination: host of the resolved href, or the literal 'outpost' for outpost.earthity.com
properties.is_outbound: true when the destination host differs from the page host
properties.email_domain: domain part of a submitted email, no local part (e.g. 'acme.com')
properties.step: drone-program Stack step id ('01'..'06'); also the numeric step index for onboarding + tour step events
properties.step_label: human label of the Stack step (e.g. 'Mission')
properties.action: audit_event: the audit action code (see lib/activity/actions.ts)
properties.via: join_requested: how the org was discovered ('domain' | 'search')
properties.subject_user_id: audit_event: the affected user (null when the actor acted on self)
properties.is_view_as: audit_event: true when an admin acted on another user's workspace
properties.is_demo: super-property stamped on every app event AND session recording: true for anonymous demo sessions (segments demo exploration from real-user activity)
properties.open: entity_detail_panel_toggled: true when the panel is open after the toggle
properties.durationMs: perf events (client_fetch_timed, optimistic_commit_timed): measured duration in milliseconds
properties.ok: perf events: whether the operation succeeded
properties.path: client_fetch_timed: request pathname (no query string / PII)
properties.total: tour events: total number of steps in the guided tour
properties.key: tour_step_viewed / tour_skipped: the step's target key (e.g. 'overview'|'docks'|'fleet'|'integration')

urlStitch.note: www appends ?distinct_id=<posthog.get_distinct_id()> (plus pass-through utm_*) to outpost-bound CTA hrefs at click time; the app reads it as posthog bootstrap.distinctID when no stored id exists. Hardens the .earthity.com cross-subdomain cookie stitch against Safari ITP / Brave cookie partitioning.

regions.$comment: Geo->consent 'required' bloc: EEA (EU-27 + IS/LI/NO) + UK + CH = 32 ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Visitors here are opt-out by default; missing/unknown country fails closed to 'required'. Consumed by earthity-website/middleware.js (REQUIRED_REGIONS) and earthity-dev/lib/analytics/regions.ts (REQUIRED_REGIONS). Must match both byte-for-byte.
